div.head: Northu 65
div.ab: Ac healde gehwa mid rihte his æwe þa hwile þe heo libbe; buton þæt gewurðe, þæt hi buta geceosan be biscopes geþeahte, þæt hi getwæman ⁊ þanon forð willan clænnesse healdan.
Ac healde gehwa mid rihte his æwe þa hwile þe heo libbe; buton þæt gewurðe, þæt hi buta geceosan be biscopes geþeahte, þæt hi getwæman and þanon forð willan clænnesse healdan.

Vielmehr behalte jeder rechtmässig seine Ehefrau so lange sie lebt; ausser wenn es geschieht, dass sie beide unter des Bischofs Beistimmung sich entschliessen, dass sie sich scheiden und hinfort Keuschheit halten wollen.
Rather let everyone lawfully keep his wife as long as she lives; unless it happens that they both choose, with the bishop's counsel, to separate and henceforth keep chastity.
But each is to keep rightly his legal wife as long as she lives; unless it comes about that they both choose to separate with the bishop’s advice and wish thenceforth to preserve chastity.
But everyone is to keep his lawful wife as is right while she lives, unless it so happens with the bishop’s guidance that they both decide to separate and remain celibate henceforth.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.

Liebermann compares I Cn.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘But each is to keep rightly his legal wife as long as she lives; unless it comes about that they both choose to separate with the bishop's advice and wish henceforth to preserve chastity.’).
